    ChartCardType
    The built-in chart card type: a JSON5 body naming a helper, a legacy flat kind, or a raw ECharts option, with data from exactly one of src=, an inline data array or a source (data: topic).

    DatatablesCardType
    The built-in datatables card type, registered through META-INF/services: validates the author catalog and resolves per-column search metadata, with no shape lift — the catalog stays in author shape (key/label, not VIEW_META's data/title); NS.card.liftCatalog (juneau-views.js) does the lift at mount time.
    final class 
    JobLogCardType
    The built-in job-log card type: a form that submits to an endpoint returning an AsyncJobRef, then streams the job's progress from AsyncJobsMixin into a log pane, with cancel and reload re-attach.

    The built-in terminal card type: validates a {contractVersion:'1', terminal:{...}} body through TerminalDef and emits {terminal: ...}.
